overview: BipDeep ContentMagic is a productivity app for social media creators. Generate AI-powered text content — posts, captions, and stories — for any platform. Save drafts, pick templates, and control tone to match your brand voice. Tagline: Create. Enchant. Repeat.
features: AI text generation for social media posts, captions, and stories
Platform selector: Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok
Tone selector: professional, casual, humorous, inspirational
Template library: Product Post, Story Hook, Quote, Call-to-Action
Draft management: save, edit, and delete your generated content
User accounts with secure sign-in via Internet Identity
Responsive design for web, tablet, and mobile
Dashboard with quick stats on your content activity
